facts.fact: Appears to be a young man, young enough to be a grandchild of an old man
Hair is long enough to fall loose over his face and be swept back
Appears to be a young man
Eyes carry a faint blood-red glow (blood light)
facts.quote: 사내, 혈주는 은은한 혈광(血光)이 서린 눈으로 돌바닥에 머리를 찧으며 부르짖는 술사들을 굽어보았다.

facts.fact: Lost one arm to Sword Saint Mae Jonghak's strike during the Shaolin Blood Incident
Lost both arms (which he had barely managed to regrow)

ranges.description: Blood Lord appears as a young man, young enough to pass for an old man's grandchild. His long hair falls loose over his face and is swept back with a hand. His eyes carry a faint blood-red glow. Tags: male, young man, long loose hair, swept-back hair, faint blood-red glow in eyes

Blood Lord appears as a young man with long hair that falls loose over his face and is swept back. His eyes are blood-red and glint sharply. He has lost one arm and has only a single arm. Tags: male, young man, long loose hair, blood-red eyes, one-armed, missing arm

Blood Lord appears as a young man with long hair that falls loose over his face and is swept back. His eyes are red and glint sharply, and he has a red tongue that he licks across his lips. Both of his arms are missing. Tags: male, young man, long loose hair, red eyes, red tongue, armless, both arms missing
